title: Chapter 425 Venerable Shenyun
content:
Chapter 425 Venerable Shenyun

"Oh, Shen Xingdao, it's no wonder you act recklessly. It turns out that you have such a backer." Zhong Yu suddenly realized.

"You know, my Immortal Dao is powerful, and I am also the leader of the six southern provinces. If you hurt me, the revenge of the Divine Star Dao will definitely not be something you can bear. If you are sensible Let me go early and kowtow to apologize, my lord does not count the faults of villains, so it is nothing if I forgive you." The Taoist saw that the person in front of him knew the majesty of Shen Xing Dao, and he was a little afraid in his words, so he immediately became proud, and even now The situation is forgotten.

"Oh! Is the Dao of the Gods amazing? It's just an earth immortal. Even if you add a few celestial masters, it's just like an ant. How dare you act recklessly like this? I really don't know what it means to make trouble in the imperial capital, and I'm getting impatient." Zhong Yu sneered, looking at the clown-like demon in front of him, he was even more disgusted in his heart.

"What the Lord said is very true. It is the people of these sects who wantonly despise the king's authority. They act according to their own will in every move and do not care about the laws of the empire. They should be punished. As the leader of the southern sect, Shen Xingdao not only does not lead by example, You dare to take the lead in breaking the law, and the ministers think that we should send a large army to conquer and destroy it, so as to frighten the empire." Donghuang Taiyi beside him also bowed to suggest.

"You... you are so bold, my Shen Xingdao doesn't take it seriously, your death is imminent, my Shen Xingdao will never let you go." Yao Dao said with a face full of fear and anger.

"Don't worry, if God Xing Dao doesn't come to settle accounts with us, we will also find him to hold him accountable. But now is not the time to talk about these things, now let's talk about how to deal with you, the demon of cholera order." Zhong Yu said.

"You disturbed the order on the street, affected the pedestrians in the surrounding shops, and committed the crime of gathering a crowd to make a noise. Then you used the demon law to steal people's money and violated the two crimes of the ban on arms and theft. According to the laws of the empire, you should be sentenced to death. For serious crimes, he should be beheaded, and the blood of dogs should be hung in the downtown area for people to watch, and his soul should be drawn out and sent to the spirit prison for imprisonment and punishment to atone for his crime."

But when Zhong Yu announced his guilt and the subsequent disposal plan, he completely lost his composure just now, and became flustered and kept shouting.

However, Zhong Yu ignored it, and asked his followers to take the Taoist priest who had no resistance to the nearby county government, and let the officials there punish him according to his own disposal.

Afterwards, Zhong Yu turned his head to look at the pear vendor, and said to him.

"You are extremely stingy, and you deserve to suffer this disaster, but after all, this Taoist priest took advantage of it and made you lose money. I gave you the total amount of silver you have here, and I gave it to you on behalf of the government. Remember to be more generous in the future, so as not to lose money Revenge against these narrow-minded people."

This peddler is so stingy, although it is extremely disgusting, but it is also forced by life.

Just like this seizing a house, he pestered the peddler, and the peddler gave him a Sydney. Then other beggars and pedestrians also surrounded him and asked him for money. Should the peddler give it or not?

If you give it, although there are many hawker pears, there are more people who want it. In a short while, these large baskets of pears will be asked for.

If these greedy people are not entangled, obstructing the peddler from doing business, and letting him spend his day in vain, what can the peddler do.

Therefore, this opening must never be opened, and no matter how the Taoist priest asks, the peddler cannot give it. The livelihood given to him was almost destroyed, which made his family who were waiting for the pear money to bear it.

Zhong Yu also saw this reason, so he didn't reprimand the hawker, because this is just the way of life and survival of the low-level people, and there is nothing worthy of criticism.

...

There is a mountain 3,000 miles away from Jiangdu City, which is 10,000 meters high, soaring into the clouds and surrounded by clouds and mist.

Dozens of huge palaces are paved on the top of the peak, each palace is extremely luxurious, but also reveals a thick majesty, it is not a mortal thing at first glance.

In the center of the palace group, in a large hall with a letter to Jiyun Temple at the door, there are more than ten old men with white beard and hair sitting cross-legged, each of them has an extraordinary bearing and looks like a fairy.

At this time, these old men were discussing about the newly-emerged Yuguo, they were constantly arguing with each other, each had their own opinions, and they refused to give in to each other.

"Master, masters, something is wrong!" At this moment, a cry came from outside the door.

Then, a little Taoist priest in a moon white Taoist robe rushed in, knelt down on the ground with a look of grief on his face.

"What's the rush! What's going on, that you're so disregarding your manners." One of the old men said with a dignified face and a serious expression.

"Yes, Elder Law Enforcement." When the little Taoist was told by the old man, he immediately remembered his upright and merciless methods of enforcing law in the past.

"Master, elders, this disciple is responsible for maintaining the execution of the Divine Destiny Pavilion. Just now, a life fire in the Divine Destiny Pavilion went out. The disciple checked, but found that it was the fate of Qingyun Palace Master Qingyun Elder, panicked , so I have no manners, and hurried to report."

"What? Junior Brother Qingyun's life fire has been extinguished. Who is it? Who dares to kill my elder of Shenxingdao?" He asked three times in a row, showing the anger of the speaker.

"Brother Sect Leader, before Junior Brother Qing Yun left, he seemed to have said that he was going to find trouble with the Imperial Kingdom, that he wanted to express the evil spirit of this ordinary dynasty restricting us cultivators, and destroy his prestige." Elder Bi Yungong Open your mouth and say.

"What, a mere secular dynasty, a small rebel who has just risen up, dares to hurt the elder of my God Star Dao, who gave him the courage?" The law enforcement elder raised his eyebrows and said angrily.

"Okay, junior brother, please be quiet for a moment. The specific situation is not clear yet, so don't jump to conclusions." Said Venerable Shenyun, the head of Shenxingdao.

"Senior Brother Sect Leader is right. Although Junior Brother Qingyun said he was going to trouble the secular dynasty, he only went there on behalf of the younger brother. It remains to be determined whether the secular dynasty did it or not," Shen Xing said. Palace Master Songyun, who has always been known for his generosity and kindness, persuaded him.

"Junior Brother Songyun's words are reasonable, and it's really inappropriate to jump to conclusions. Let's do this. Junior Brother Songyun and the law enforcement elders will lead a group of Jingan children to go to the capital of the ordinary dynasty. Bring me back to my Shenxing Dao, and deal with it." Venerable Shenyun said with great confidence.

In his impression, the small mortal dynasty had just risen not long ago, and its background was shallow, and there were probably only eight or nine strong men above the sixth rank, and this still counted the governors of the Ming Dynasty who surrendered.

With this little strength, my own junior and a law enforcement elder are more than enough.
